name: Collateral Parameters 10
definition: Parameters which explicitly state the conditions that must be fulfilled before a particular triparty collateral instruction/transaction  can be confirmed. These parameters are defined by the instructing party in compliance with triparty collateral rules in the market the instruction/transaction will take place.

CollateralInstructionType.name: Collateral Instruction Type
CollateralInstructionType.definition: Specifies the type of collateral instruction.

ExposureType.name: Exposure Type
ExposureType.definition: Specifies the underlying business area/type of trade causing the exposure.

CollateralSide.name: Collateral Side
CollateralSide.definition: Specifies whether the client is the collateral taker or giver.

ValueSoughtMarginRate.name: Value Sought Margin Rate
ValueSoughtMarginRate.definition: Percentage by which the collateral value sought is increased, in selecting securities for a collateral basket, to reflect the taker's margin requirements.|Margin or haircut to be applied on the exposure amount, expressed  as a percentage.

TransferTitle.name: Transfer Title
TransferTitle.definition: Change of title for the collateral. If N then collateral is pledged.

SettlementProcess.name: Settlement Process
SettlementProcess.definition: Specifies the settlement process in which the collateral will be settled.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Specifies the priority with which the instruction needs to be executed.

AutomaticAllocation.name: Automatic Allocation
AutomaticAllocation.definition: Specifies whether the allocation of the collateral is manual or automatic.

FailedSettlementSalvation.name: Failed Settlement Salvation
FailedSettlementSalvation.definition: Specifies whether the taker is allowed to solve the failing settlement by proposing other collateral movements.

MainTradingAccountCollateralisation.name: Main Trading Account Collateralisation
MainTradingAccountCollateralisation.definition: Specifies if the main trading account  is included in the pool of securities positions available for collateralisation. It is used in case of re-use of collateral to specify the account from which the securities collateral is taken from.

BasketIdentificationAndEligibilitySetPro.name: Basket Identification And Eligibility Set Profile
BasketIdentificationAndEligibilitySetPro.definition: Provides information on the baskets identification and the Eligibility Set Profile.

ResponseStatus.name: Response Status
ResponseStatus.definition: Collateral taker's answer to the collateral giver instruction.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides additional information to a collateral instruction.

MainTradingAccountCollateralisationGuide.definition: If the indicator is not present then the default interpretation is that the main trading account is included in the pool of securities positions available for collateralisation (re-use)

MainTradingAccountCollateralisationProvi.definition: The Main Trading Account Collateralisation indicator can be present only if the collateral side is the provider of collateral.

MainTradingAccountCollateralisationTrans.definition: The Main Trading Account Collateralisation Indicator can be present only if the Collateral Transaction Type is an initiation, a collateral adjustment, a principal adjustment or a margin adjustment.
